# ClickTake Technologies

> ClickTake Technologies is an AI-native software engineering firm shipping production-grade software, autonomous AI agents, cloud architecture, digital marketing, and creative services. 24 services across 4 practices, serving 13 cities in 4 continents since 2019.

## Services

ClickTake offers 24 services across 4 practices:

### Digital Marketing
- [PPC / Paid Ads](https://clicktaketech.com/ppc-paid-ads): Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok — profitable CPA
- [SEO Services](https://clicktaketech.com/seo-services): Technical, on-page, off-page, local pack
- [Content Strategy & SEO](https://clicktaketech.com/content-strategy-seo): Topical authority, content clusters
- [Conversion Rate Optimization](https://clicktaketech.com/conversion-rate-optimization): A/B testing, 25-60% CVR lift
- [Social Media Marketing](https://clicktaketech.com/social-media-marketing): Organic, paid, community, influencer
- [SEO & Web Design](https://clicktaketech.com/seo-web-design-services): PageSpeed 90+, schema, indexable builds

### Web & Software
- [Full-Stack Web Development](https://clicktaketech.com/full-stack-web-development): Next.js 16, TypeScript, Prisma
- [SaaS Platform Engineering](https://clicktaketech.com/saas-platform-engineering): Multi-tenant, Stripe billing, RBAC
- [Auth & Identity](https://clicktaketech.com/auth-identity): NextAuth, OAuth/SAML, passkeys
- [Python Backend & APIs](https://clicktaketech.com/python-backend-apis): FastAPI, async workers, p99 120ms
- [WordPress Web Design](https://clicktaketech.com/wordpress-web-design-services): WooCommerce, ACF, headless WP
- [Ecommerce Web Design](https://clicktaketech.com/ecommerce-web-design-services): Headless Shopify/Medusa, 1.5s LCP

### AI & Automation
- [Custom LLM Solutions](https://clicktaketech.com/custom-llm-solutions): RAG, fine-tuning, eval harness
- [AI Chatbots & Assistants](https://clicktaketech.com/ai-chatbots-assistants): Tool-use, memory, human handoff
- [Prompt Engineering](https://clicktaketech.com/prompt-engineering): Versioning, eval suites, cost optimization
- [AI Automation](https://clicktaketech.com/ai-automation): 30+ hrs/wk saved, human-in-the-loop
- [AI Agent Development](https://clicktaketech.com/ai-agent-development): LangGraph, planning, memory, multi-agent
- [Computer Vision & NLP](https://clicktaketech.com/computer-vision-nlp): OCR, object detection, document AI

### Creative & Brand
- [Professional Web Design](https://clicktaketech.com/professional-web-design-services): UX research, Figma, hi-fi prototypes
- [Web Design Services](https://clicktaketech.com/web-design-services): End-to-end design systems, UI kits
- [Small Business Web Design](https://clicktaketech.com/small-business-web-design-services): Fast launch, local-SEO, easy CMS
- [Responsive Web Design](https://clicktaketech.com/responsive-web-design-services): Mobile-first, fluid layouts, WCAG 2.2 AA
- [Graphic Design](https://clicktaketech.com/graphic-design): Brand identity, logos, collateral, guidelines
- [B2B Video Production](https://clicktaketech.com/b2b-video-production): Explainers, demos, ad creatives
